quotes_used_verbatim: All rates posted on this website are based on double occupancy. A single guest who wishes to have a stateroom to themselves will be expected to pay 200% of the category rate, unless otherwise noted in the pricing.
primary_sources.attribution: Quoted as Royal Caribbean's own stated single-occupancy policy.
Royal Caribbean's own loyalty statement; the 14-points-on-7-nights example is given on the same page.

quotes_used_verbatim: Solo Staterooms are priced for one
Double occupancy rates don\u2019t apply. Solo Staterooms are always priced for one.
Studio Lounge is only available for Solo Studio accommodations.
primary_sources.attribution: Quoted as Norwegian Cruise Line's own stateroom-page statements. The Studio Lounge restriction is quoted specifically because it contradicts a claim repeated widely elsewhere.

claims.no_prices: NO fare figure, solo supplement amount, or price estimate for any sailing appears in the article. The example arithmetic ($899 becoming $1,798) is explicitly an illustration of doubling, using an arbitrary round number, not a quoted or observed fare.
claims.not_claimed: NO claim about the number of solo cabins on any ship or in any fleet - the text says the count moves and directs the reader to the deck plan. NO claim about which lines currently run reduced-supplement promotions. NO claim that any non-Royal-Caribbean line uses the 200% figure. The Celebrity and Silversea loyalty details seen on the Royal Caribbean page were NOT used, because they were not needed and were not separately verified on those lines' own pages.
claims.editorial: The 'why it exists' section is the site's own economic reasoning and is labelled in the text as explanation rather than quotation. The four levers, the cheaper-cabin comparison, and the closing paragraph about who solo travellers actually are, are the site's own.
claims.correction_flagged: The article explicitly corrects the widespread claim that Studio Lounge access comes with all Norwegian solo cabins, citing the line's own qualification.
claims.authority_deferral: The article states that the deck plan for the reader's specific ship and sailing date is the authoritative answer on solo cabin availability.
